name: Türkiye Resmi Tatilleri
religiousHolidaysNote: Ramazan Bayramı and Kurban Bayramı entries below follow the lunar Hijri calendar and shift every Gregorian year - this file intentionally does NOT compute them. Only a couple of near-term dates are seeded (recurringAnnually=false), each carrying a 'note' flagging it as an estimate pending official Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı confirmation. A Platform admin MUST add a fresh row for each subsequent year (see HolidayCalendarEntry's class doc comment) - do not extrapolate or auto-generate future dates from these.
